title: Vice President - Demand Generation
description:
About Argano

Argano is a global specialist consultancy that helps mid-to-large enterprises run high-performance operations on the platforms they already own. We bring deep expertise across Oracle, SAP, Microsoft, Salesforce, Workday, UKG, Anaplan, Blue Yonder, Databricks, MuleSoft, and Boomi - connected by Argano Connect, our system-agnostic data and decision-intelligence layer - and industry depth in healthcare, life sciences, financial services, energy and utilities, retail, wholesale and distribution, and homebuilding. Our clients choose us because we pair publisher-level depth with an outcomes-first, client-centric way of working.
The Role

Marketing at Argano is shifting from a collection of business-unit efforts to a single, scalable demand engine. The VP, Demand Generation will build and lead that engine: a Demand Center of Excellence that designs, executes, and continuously improves campaigns for every Argano business unit, runs account-based marketing for our most strategic accounts, and owns the channels and content that move buyers from awareness to pipeline.
This is a builder’s role with a revenue mandate. You will be accountable, in partnership with business-unit marketing leaders, for each business unit hitting its lead and marketing-sourced pipeline targets. You will set the operating model, hire and develop the team, install the campaign system the CoE runs on, and get campaigns into market fast by partnering closely with Marketing and Campaign Operations, Creative, and Events.
What You’ll Own

Build the Demand Center of Excellence

• Design and stand up the Demand CoE: charter, operating model, team structure, roles, and the intake, prioritization, and service-level model that business units use to bring campaigns to market.

• Establish repeatable campaign “containers” - defined audience, cadence, creative recipe, offer and CTA, measurement plan, and stop condition - so every program is planned, launched, and measured the same way across business units.

• Build the shared calendar and Plan-on-a-Page discipline that shows leadership what is in market, what is coming, and what each program is expected to produce.

• Hire, coach, and develop a high-performing team of campaign, ABM, email, webinar, and content professionals; set clear goals and build a culture of speed, rigor, and accountability.

Campaign Strategy and Execution

• Own integrated campaign strategy and execution for all Argano business units, from campaign brief to in-market launch to post-campaign readout.

• Translate each business unit’s offerings, ICP, and pipeline plan into an annual and quarterly campaign plan with explicit lead and pipeline targets by program.

• Partner with business-unit marketers to tailor messaging, offers, and content to publisher ecosystems (Oracle, SAP, Microsoft, Salesforce, and others) and to priority industries.

- Identify underutilized resources and other sources of waste, then partner with engineering teams to deliver and measure improvements while preserving performance and reliability.
